## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix how `--json` takes its path before merge: when another flag follows `--json`, the parser reads that flag as the JSON path. This breaks the combined `--json`/`--junit` use that the pull-request description promises.

## Changes
The pull request adds a `--json` option to `parse_args` that takes an optional path and falls back to `results.json`. It also adds `write_reports`, which writes each report to the destination it was parsed for, and new tests in `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Skip flag tokens when choosing the --json path — `parse_args(["--json", "--junit", "out.xml"])` sets `json` to `"--junit"` and then raises `ValueError("unknown option: out.xml")`, because line 15 uses any next token as the path. The comment at line 12 says the default applies "when no path is supplied", but that only happens when `--json` is the last argument. — Users who put `--json` before `--junit` get an error instead of both reports, and the added tests do not cover this order. — Fix: Copy the `--junit` check at `app/cli.py:7` and only use `args[i + 1]` when it exists and does not start with `"--"`, then add a `["--json", "--junit", "x.xml"]` case to `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
